sources.description:
林凡回歸新歌宣傳照

林凡身穿綠色高領背心與長手套，優雅地坐在深色木椅上，旁邊擺放白色與紫色花卉，整體色調柔和時尚。這組宣傳照用於宣傳她時隔五年推出的回歸單曲《如果那天》，新歌以輕快的R&B風格為主，旨在擺脫她在《犀利人妻》中專唱虐心情歌的既有印象。

自加盟華納音樂後，林凡重拾歌手身份，並在過去五年中擔任廣播DJ、演出音樂劇《偷心情歌》及駐唱歌手。她在2018年失去父親，遺憾未能在金曲獎上當面感謝，並感謝家人與日籍男友的支持。全新單曲與MV將於9月20日同步上線，標誌她正式回歸歌壇。

sources.description:
林凡回歸歌壇宣傳照

林凡身著黑紅拼色上衣，站在明亮的室內走廊窗邊，微笑中流露自信與親和力。這張宣傳照用以配合她睽違五年推出的新單曲〈如果那天〉，展現她活潑、輕快的R&B風格，並擺脫過去在《犀利人妻》中專唱虐心情歌的印象。

過去五年，林凡曾擔任廣播DJ、演出音樂劇《偷心情歌》並擔任駐唱歌手，工作始終與音樂息息相關。2018年1月父親過世成為她的低潮，未能在金曲獎上公開感謝父親令她深感遺憾。新歌與MV於9月20日同步上線，MV由導演陳映之執導，象徵她重返歌壇的全新開始。

sources.description:
Lin Fan’s Promotional Portrait

Lin Fan poses confidently in a sleek black dress featuring a diagonal cascade of silver fringe beads. Her straight hair frames her face, complemented by bold earrings and thigh-high black boots, creating a modern and elegant look.

This portrait likely promotes her appearance at the “但願人長久” Teresa Teng tribute concert on June 6 at the Kaohsiung Music Center’s Haiyin Hall. The event, part of the 17th Kaohsiung Spring Arts Festival, will feature Lin Fan alongside Peng Jiahui and Cao Yawen, honoring Teresa Teng’s enduring legacy 31 years after her passing.

sources.description:
Lin Fan’s Poised Return

Lin Fan sits serenely in a tailored white blazer against a white brick wall, her auburn hair softly framing her face. The minimalist setting and monochromatic palette emphasize her composed expression and modern elegance.

After a seven-year break, Lin Fan is set to release her new single “名人錄,” a light, micro-electronic track dedicated to four key figures in her life: her mother, her mentor Lin Mingyang, a past love, and her idol Sandy Lam. During the pandemic, she stayed home practicing yoga, reading, cooking with her mother, and preparing for her musical comeback.
